title: Gradient of Multivariate Gaussian Log-PDF
seoDescription: Compute the gradient of a multivariate Gaussian log density with respect to its mean vector.
description:
Compute the gradient of the multivariate Gaussian log-density with respect to its mean vector.

$$
\nabla_\mu \log \mathcal{N}(x; \mu, \Sigma) = \Sigma^{-1} (x - \mu)
$$

Given input parameters `x`, `mean`, `cov`, return list of float gradients with respect to each mean coordinate.

### 💡 Intuition & Approach
**Gradient of Multivariate Gaussian Log-PDF** (Calculus, Probability and Statistics): Compute the gradient of a multivariate Gaussian log density with respect to its mean vector.

To implement `calculus_gaussian_mean_gradient` cleanly and accurately:
1. Parse and normalize the inputs (`x`, `mean`, `cov`) into floating-point arrays or structured containers.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
import numpy as np

def calculus_gaussian_mean_gradient(x: list, mean: list, cov: list) -> list:
    return np.round(np.dot(np.linalg.inv(np.array(cov, dtype=np.float64)), np.array(x, dtype=np.float64) - np.array(mean, dtype=np.float64)), 6).tolist()
```
